definition_used: Any question, controversy or dispute about third party involvement.
caution: The definition is extremely broad and does not specify the nature of the involvement, making it a status/notice signal about third-party involvement rather than a direct indicator of manuscript content or process flaws. It is best treated as a post-publication transparency marker.
semantic_rationale: The definition 'Any question, controversy or dispute about third party involvement' directly signals a third-party investigation context, which aligns with post-publication oversight. It does not inherently indicate issues with research content, authorship, or editorial processes, so only the transparency category is assigned.
